name: design-preview
description: Real-component visual decisions for Vite (React or Vue/Nuxt) and Laravel Blade/Livewire projects: renders 2-3 candidate variants with the project's OWN components on its own dev server, on a scratch surface removed at cleanup, behind a strict consent gate. The Vite path adds an extra HTML entry and touches no existing file; the Laravel path also adds one marked line to routes/web.php, named in the consent gate first. Escalation tier above static shell mockups — falls back to them when neither stack is detected. Includes /design-preview:preview.
